## Featured Projects

- **[DSAC System](https://github.com/marioswc/dsac)** (2026) — Web platform for managing clients, appointments, services, and tax/accounting files for an accounting firm. Built with Laravel, PHP, MySQL, Tailwind CSS, and Alpine.js. Features public landing page, client tax & file management, multi-status appointment scheduling flow, PDF generation, email notifications, dynamic service catalog, and role-based admin portals.
- **[DailyQuo](https://dailyquo.vercel.app/)** (2026) — Minimalist web application that delivers a single inspirational quote for each day of the year, built in React and JavaScript with external API integration, day-of-year quote mapping, automatic midnight rollover, local storage caching, debounced clipboard copy, and modular hook architecture. Source code: [https://github.com/marioswc/dailyquo](https://github.com/marioswc/dailyquo)
- **[TaskFlow](https://to-do-list-ten-bay-47.vercel.app/)** (2026) — Fast, zero-dependency task management web application built with modular vanilla JavaScript, HTML, Tailwind CSS, and Vite. Features seamless task CRUD, persistent browser storage, and context-aware empty states. Source code: [https://github.com/marioswc/to-do-list](https://github.com/marioswc/to-do-list)
